text:
maria: customer on v2 SDK reporting sudden latency spikes + duplicate billing, says requests are routed to eu-west then us-west within same call. attached logs and repro steps.
chloe: seeing 2x tokens charged in invoice for same session id, latency 400ms -> 1.2s mid-call, happens intermittently. I can share a small repro if needed.
maria: thx @chloe, dropping request_id and truncated logs:
```
request_id=rc_2026-03-16-22
sdk_version=2.4.1
client_ts=2026-03-16T22:11:03Z
TRACE: sent to eu-west-1 -> timeout 200ms -> hedged retry to us-west-2 -> successful 1.15s
```
ajay: interesting — hedged retries + affinity mismatch looks likely. @maria can you confirm client retry config? backoff, hedged timeout, and whether the SDK has `region_affinity` enabled?
maria: customer using default config. they call `client.generate(...)` with no explicit region pin. SDK default hedged is enabled for low-latency: hedged_timeout=200ms, max_retries=1.
kelly: that matches pattern: request goes to primary region, hedged retry fires to fallback region, both succeed -> downstream counts both charges if tenant-level dedupe not applied. we saw similar telemetry but usually cleared by regional dedupe in gateway. looks like this tenant bypasses gateway dedupe because of direct routing.
sam: quick repro script I asked chloe to run (JS):
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/runtime');
const client = new Redwood.Client({sdk_version: '2.4.1'});
for (let i=0;i<5;i++) {
  client.generate({prompt: 'ping', max_tokens: 5}).then(console.log).catch(console.error);
}
```
chloe: ran it 5x, saw 2 calls with logs showing dual-region handoff, invoice shows 2x for those calls.
ajay: can you paste a single raw http trace for one dual-charge event? headers are important (x-region, x-request-parent, x-hedge).
maria: adding raw trace snippet:
```
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-region-served: eu-west-1
x-hedge-request: true
x-fallback-region: us-west-2
x-request-id: rc_2026-03-16-22
```
kelly: note `x-hedge-request: true` — gateway should emit a dedupe id and only bill winner. looks like gateway dedupe didn't apply because request lacked `x-dedupe-key` or the client used direct edge -> dedicated pool routing that bypasses dedupe.
ajay: short-term mitigation: ask customer to disable hedged retries or enable `region_affinity: true` to pin region for session. Long-term: add server-side dedupe for direct routes and ensure hedged fallback sets `x-dedupe-key`.
sam: also pushing patch in SDK to set `x-dedupe-key` for hedged attempts and to surface a `region_affinity` boolean in client config. PR link: https://git.redwood/patch/1234 (internal).
maria: sent steps to customer: 1) set env REDWOOD_REGION_AFFINITY=true or update client config; 2) if using default hedged behavior, increase hedged_timeout to 500ms to reduce fallback; 3) run repro and send new trace.
chloe: applying region affinity now, will retest and report back. thanks! :pray:
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1997 linked to tenant rc_2026-03-16-22 for "hedged-client double-charge". assigned to eng-runtime.
ajay: I'll own the incident. immediate action items: patch SDK (sam), add gate for direct-route dedupe (kelly), update docs with hedged behavior (sam).
maria: marking escalation to billing to inspect invoices for tenant and apply refund if confirmed duplicate charges.
chloe: confirmed after pinning region the calls show single-region routing, latency stable, no duplicate line items so far. will confirm billing after next invoice.
ajay: thanks all — follow-up: we'll release SDK patch in next minor, and I'll post status once server dedupe is enforced. :white_check_mark:
